text: 欧洲央行：预计2026年CPI增长3%，此前预测为2.6%；预计2027年CPI增长2.5%，此前预测为2.3%；预计2028年CPI增长2.1%，此前预测为2%。 预计2026年核心CPI（剔除食品和能源）增长2.5%，与此前预测持平；预计2027年核心CPI增长2.6%，此前预测为2.5%；预计2028年核心CPI增长2.3%，此前预测为2.2%。
text_en: European Central Bank: CPI is expected to rise 3% in 2026, previously forecast at 2.6%; CPI is expected to rise 2.5% in 2027, previously forecast at 2.3%; CPI is expected to rise 2.1% in 2028, previously forecast at 2%. Core CPI (excluding food and energy) is expected to rise 2.5% in 2026, unchanged from the previous forecast; core CPI is expected to rise 2.6% in 2027, previously forecast at 2.5%; core CPI is expected to rise 2.3% in 2028, previously forecast at 2.2%.
